notes: «أن عائشة، أرادت أن تشتري، بريرة» describes Aisha's action, reported by الأسود: she is not a link here (rule 6, action described); the chain ends at الأسود as written.
«وأتي النبي ... بلحم» has no transmitter of its own, so it is part of this chain and carries no saying label.
«حدثنا آدم حدثنا شعبة وزاد فخيرت من زوجها» is a wording addition from the same shaykh: left out (pure wording variant).
